title: The Timeline revamp PR added IssueBulkUpdateDateEndpoint, which fetches issues by caller-supplied ids without filtering by the URL's workspace and project, so a member of any project can change start/target dates of any issue on the instance.

vulnerable_findings.explanation: The IssueDetailEndpoint and IssueBulkUpdateDateEndpoint retrieve issues based solely on URL parameters (slug, project_id, issue ids) after a role‑based permission check. There is no verification that the requesting user actually belongs to the workspace or project, allowing a user to access or modify any issue by supplying arbitrary identifiers (IDOR).

findings.explanation: The new code uses Django ORM querysets with filter(**filters) and annotated subqueries; no raw SQL strings are constructed from user input, so there is no direct SQL injection vector.

evidence.content:
issue = (
    Issue.issue_objects.filter(
        workspace__slug=slug, project_id=project_id
    )
    .select_related(...)
    .annotate(...)
    ...
)
issue = issue.filter(**filters)

There is no verification that the requesting user actually belongs to the workspace or project, allowing a user to access or modify any issue by supplying arbitrary identifiers (IDOR).
findings.suggested_fix: Add ownership/visibility checks after fetching the objects, e.g., verify that each issue's workspace and project belong to the requesting user (or that the user has explicit access) before returning or updating them.
